verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents transfer-in mechanics like pausing the transfer to set up DNS first, bulk submission of up to 500 domains, and a dedicated GoDaddy-migration guide, plus general API support for 'register, renew, transfer' domains — giving a real but partial picture of the transfer-in flow. However none of the evidence explicitly discusses the EPP/auth-code exchange, transfer status tracking states, transfer pricing, or what happens to remaining registration time (ICANN convention of adding a year) — the core 'honesty' details the story asks about are absent. Missing for 10: explicit EPP/auth-code documentation, transfer cost disclosure, status-tracking detail, and remaining-registration-time handling.
